ast_kinds.always: records into test hooks; not a value
ast_kinds.sometimes: records into test hooks; not a value
ast_kinds.deftest: a test declaration; its body records into hooks
ast_kinds.defapp: its init, update and view are ordinary defs, called as defs

stdlib.JSON.parse: decoding depends on the target type; rt/json.ex is a later stage
stdlib.JSON.stringify: encoding depends on the static type; rt/json.ex is a later stage
stdlib.Tx.Op: transaction ops need the transaction coordinator
stdlib.Tx.delete: a special form naming a stored model; needs the transaction coordinator
stdlib.Cmd.store.tx: its body takes a Store and returns Tx ops

ascii_only.String.to_upper: specified on ASCII input only: Lean's Char case functions are ASCII-only
ascii_only.String.to_lower: specified on ASCII input only: Lean's Char case functions are ASCII-only
